caption: The drawing depicts a long-sleeved, fitted jacket with a high collar, extending down to mid-thigh length and flaring outward below the waist. The jacket features a pattern of vertical stripes with small floral or leaf motifs in blue, yellow, and green on a black background. The buttons are arranged vertically down the front center, and the inside of the lower front opening reveals a brownish-red lining. The sleeves are slightly puffed at the shoulders, and the jacket has a tailored, hourglass shape. The entire object is centered on a plain, light beige background, and there is a small signature in the bottom right corner.
title: Black Satin Jacket
